architecture.mechanism: Hybrid PID-FOPID control strategy coupled with an EF2 resonant DC-DC converter for voltage stabilization and reduced battery dependency
architecture.intervention: Integrate a fuel-cell-backed EF2 resonant DC-DC converter regulated by the hybrid PID-FOPID controller to maintain minimum bus voltage during spontaneous battery drain, ensuring sufficient power to retain diagnostic trouble codes in non-volatile memory and energize the shift interlock solenoid.
architecture.expected_effect: The converter sustains system voltage above the ECU memory retention threshold and shift interlock actuation threshold during deep discharge events, preventing loss of diagnostic trouble codes and enabling gear selection even when the primary battery is depleted.
architecture.falsification_test: Disconnect the primary battery under load and measure whether the EF2 converter maintains bus voltage above 9V; verify that diagnostic trouble codes persist in ECU memory and the shift interlock releases within 500ms of brake pedal application.
